name: bellteam-lattice-module
description: Child-only dependencies of the lattice module payload; Owner 2026-11-14: always the latest Lattice, no exact pin (the lock records the resolved version) (docs/architecture/modules/runtime/lattice-child.md). @quolu/lattice 0.85.5 is the minimum: the first release with todo display read/source. 0.86.0 adds todo add (one task) for seats; 0.86.1 stops witness prompts on conversation plans; 0.87.0 adds todo independence witness declare (one task's row); 0.88.0 refuses a missing or blank design_memo (DESIGN_MEMO_REQUIRED) and adds opt-in enforced plans; 0.89.0 reports a value written by a newer Lattice as UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA (newer_lattice_value) instead of STORE_CORRUPT and adds --message to done hints on enforced plans; 0.90.0 lets witness declare record a row on a Store root with no commit (the chart dirs are git init without a commit), so enforced plans can start there, and adds startable notices (mutation result notices, todo notice list|ack); 0.91.0 accepts or rejects a phase with --message (evidence as text, no file in the Store root), so heavy phases of enforced plans can close on chart dirs without a commit; 0.92.0 adds todo wait (waiting marks on notices: waiting, waiting_digest, acked_recipients; ack set v2, v1 still reads), so the module can wake the Bots waiting on a task; 0.93.0 anchors evidence blobs under refs/lattice/evidence/<oid> so git gc keeps them (todo evidence anchor for evidence written before); 0.94.0 answers STORE_UNINITIALIZED (todo evidence anchor: exit 0, lattice.todo_evidence_anchor_uninitialized.v1) on a chart dir with no Store instead of STORE_INCONSISTENT; 0.95.0 adds todo nudge (read-only ready set per lane with fire/stop actions and a prompt) and answers STORE_UNINITIALIZED on the display reads too (display source exits 0 with project_id null); 0.96.0 adds todo blockers (read-only list of every stop on a chart); 0.97.0 lets any seat retract an in-progress task and reopen a done one (a journal with a reopen is unreadable to older Lattice: never downgrade below 0.97.0); 0.97.1 keeps a stop's time and actor in todo blockers across a plan revise (same shape); 0.98.0 removes todo nudge (unknown command; the module never calls it, its sweep reads the memo projections); 0.99.0 lets a task wait on a task of another chart (todo dependency connect --from-project, read only from LATTICE_CHARTS_ROOT, which every run sets; display read adds external_tasks); 0.100.0 adds `trees` to todo display read (a100), keeps incoming ledger edges across a revision (edge carry), and speeds revisions on large plans (validated-version memo, one-pass rebind of in-progress tasks; outage 2026-11-14); 0.101.0 adds the host connection contract (charts list/source, chart set, chart repo bind/sync, LATTICE_PROJECT_ID addressing; a101/a102); 0.102.0 makes setup exit 0 on partial (the module never calls setup); 0.102.1 cuts a task's note context at 512 entries (bellteam-dev-added has more than 512 plan notes, so note list/show/start note_context failed NOTE_PROJECTION_INVALID on every task; a150); 0.103.0 seals the plan-scoped journal at 1 MiB and continues in a new segment (bellteam-dev-added reached the cap: every write was refused plan_scoped_journal_segment_limit_exceeded; a154) and keeps task note context cut at 512 (#189); 0.104.0 lifts the 512-task cap of a plan (bellteam-dev-added refused todo add), adds the 接続 commands (todo predecessor add|remove, todo connect condition add|remove|resolve, todo connect priority; todo wait and dependency connect|disconnect stay aliases that print lattice.todo_command_retired.v1 on stderr after success) and moves status and session-context to lattice.todo_status_result.v10 (connections in status, session-context, todo show and todo display read). 0.105.0 keeps only a reverse patch for a superseded plan version and adds todo compact (lattice.todo_compact_result.v1); a compacted chart is unreadable to a child older than 0.105.0, so todo compact runs only after the 0.105.0 child is live. 0.106.0 stops verifying evidence and history on reads and writes (ADR 0203; todo verify runs only when asked), records done as plain text (task evidence {message}; legacy records stay readable) and keeps evidence_unverified in the v10 shapes, always false; a 0.105 reader refuses the new done/accept/reject shapes, so the 0.106.0 child must be live before a seat writes them. 0.107.0 adds `chart set --no-code-lane` (the module sets approval-box on the bellteam code chart; a chart carrying that key is unreadable to a child older than 0.107.0, so never roll the child back below 0.107.0), fetches depth 1 only on the first chart repo sync, excludes .lattice/sensor/ in sensor init|sync (g2) and drops the enforced done-reference gate. 0.108.0 keeps declared tasks' independence records across a plan revision, drops INDEPENDENCE_READY_UNDECLARED, writes the record above 8 declared tasks (wave_plan null) and judges a clean code chart through its maintained index.
